evidence.claim: EURATEX rappresenta dal 1996 gli interessi dell'industria tessile e dell'abbigliamento europea presso le istituzioni dell'Unione Europea.
evidence.quote: EURATEX is the European Apparel and Textile Confederation , representing the interests of the European textile and clothing industry at the level of the EU institutions. || EURATEX was officially created in 1996 with the merger of three organisations present in Brussels, all lobbying for the interests of the Textile and clothing industries since the early ‘60s.
